data.local_policy: For a new PMD packet, the office verifies the documented encounter date against the signed order date before final transmission. A signed note without an encounter date does not establish the timing interval. Staff may not infer the encounter date from the note signature or order date. A practitioner must supply a signed dated correction when no other dated encounter record is present. The supplied clinician review determines clinical merits; office staff verify documentation.
